title: Use a workflow of: start with your image → generate a storyboard using a Custom…
content: Use a workflow of: start with your image → generate a storyboard using a Custom GPT (Image 2.0) → feed the storyboard into Seedance 2.0 to produce the video.
tips: Use a workflow of: start with your image → generate a storyboard using a Custom GPT (Image 2.0) → feed the storyboard into Seedance 2.0 to produce the video.
